The Phoenix Commercial Window Film Challenge

Phoenix commercial buildings face 299+ days of sun annually with summer temperatures exceeding 115°F. East and west-facing glass generates extreme solar heat gain that overloads HVAC systems, creates uncomfortable hot zones for employees and customers, and accelerates UV degradation of interiors. Window film is the highest-ROI intervention available — no window replacement, no construction, installed around your business schedule. Arizona House of Film has completed 700+ commercial and residential projects across the Phoenix metro since 2017.

Commercial Window Film FAQs — Phoenix

How much does commercial window film cost in Phoenix?

Commercial window film in Phoenix typically ranges from $6–$18 per square foot installed, depending on film type, building height, glass condition, and access requirements. Small storefronts run $500–$2,000. Large office buildings run $5,000–$25,000+. All projects are custom-quoted after a free site assessment.

What is the best window film for Phoenix commercial buildings?

For Phoenix commercial buildings, dual-reflective solar control film is the most common choice — it rejects 50–70% of solar heat while reducing interior glare. East and west facing glass benefits most. High-rise buildings often require spectrally selective film to avoid thermal stress on existing low-e glass.

How long does commercial window film installation take?

Most small commercial jobs (storefronts, single-floor offices) are completed in one day. Large multi-floor office buildings typically take 2–5 days depending on square footage and access. We schedule around business hours to minimize disruption.

Does commercial window film qualify for energy rebates in Arizona?

Some Arizona utility providers offer commercial energy efficiency rebates for qualifying window film installations. APS and SRP have had programs in the past. We can provide documentation of film specs and projected energy savings to support rebate applications.

Do you serve all Phoenix metro commercial properties?

Yes. We serve commercial properties across Phoenix, Scottsdale, Tempe, Mesa, Chandler, Gilbert, Glendale, Peoria, Surprise, Goodyear, and the full metro area. Past clients include national chains, government facilities, medical campuses, and independent businesses.
